bug_semantics: A rating block stores customIcon.svg as an unrestricted string and, when custom icons are enabled, inserts that string into the live bot DOM as HTML. An imported malicious typebot or a malicious workspace collaborator can supply event-handler-bearing HTML/SVG; builder preview renders the bot inline on builder.typebot.io, so the payload executes in the victim's privileged builder origin rather than in the Web Worker used for isUnsafe Script blocks. This is stored XSS and an import-safety sandbox bypass.
flaw_origin: b1aecf843b28e0c06cf7c43f59cc5ebd661da416 (feat(engine): Add Rating input) introduced the complete unsafe feature in one commit: the builder accepted arbitrary Icon SVG text, the model admitted svg as an optional unconstrained string, and RatingForm passed it to React dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitization. Later folder refactors 2df833850504fa2bb8653494a0e3abb120abde1f, 972094425ae72f8b962617ec54bccb89a396efb8, and cbc8194f19396ed8f8b3ea05d75223beeab42c3c preserved that sink. The bot-v2/package-js implementation in squash 1a3869ae6d9fa92fc71ef9d981bfffb8e4ee4ecc (whose recoverable PR head is 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894) copied the pre-existing rating behavior into Solid innerHTML; it is therefore a migration/duplicate, not the causal BIC. Subsequent workspace/path refactors and be20e964474867f5bf46490877de256cb3103c55 retained the same unsanitized value until the fix.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC. `git cat-file -p b1aecf843b28e0c06cf7c43f59cc5ebd661da416` shows human author and committer Baptiste Arnaud <contact@baptiste-arnaud.fr> and only the subject `feat(engine): ✨ Add Rating input`; there are no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot-identity, or other AI trailers in the commit object.
evidence: Advisory GHSA-6m7c-xfhp-p9fh identifies packages/embeds/js/src/features/blocks/inputs/rating/components/RatingForm.tsx and the missing rating handling in apps/builder/src/features/typebot/helpers/sanitizers.ts. Reproduce the origin with `git show b1aecf843b28e0c06cf7c43f59cc5ebd661da416 -- packages/bot-engine/src/components/ChatBlock/ChatStep/inputs/RatingForm.tsx packages/models/src/typebot/steps/input/rating.ts apps/builder/components/shared/Graph/Nodes/StepNode/SettingsPopoverContent/bodies/RatingInputSettingsBody.tsx`: the new settings input writes arbitrary SVG, the new Zod field is only `z.string().optional()`, and the new renderer assigns that value to `dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html`. `git log -L 87,105:packages/bot-engine/src/features/blocks/inputs/rating/components/RatingForm.tsx e55823e0112291a32886908fd4c63365275106e6` traces the unsafe render back to b1aecf843b28e0c06cf7c43f59cc5ebd661da416. Cross-check with `git log --all -S 'customIcon.isEnabled && !isEmpty(customIcon.svg)' --` over the four historical RatingForm paths: it reports b1aecf843b28e0c06cf7c43f59cc5ebd661da416 first, followed only by moves/refactors 2df833850504fa2bb8653494a0e3abb120abde1f, 972094425ae72f8b962617ec54bccb89a396efb8, and cbc8194f19396ed8f8b3ea05d75223beeab42c3c. Direct parent check: `git cat-file -e 301097623ba841312ef66c23d514105f276a2a29:packages/bot-engine/src/components/ChatBlock/ChatStep/inputs/RatingForm.tsx` fails because the renderer does not exist, while a parent-tree `git grep` finds no rating customIcon sink. The later Solid implementation first appears in 1a3869ae6d9fa92fc71ef9d981bfffb8e4ee4ecc, but its code mirrors the already-vulnerable React renderer; its PR head 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894 has the same tree and parent as the squash, confirming it does not decompose to an earlier member. `git show 474ecbf46bc47a75265bada2599f12b2179de375` adds DOMPurify-based sanitizeSvgFragment, uses it before rating innerHTML, and sanitizes rating customIcon.svg in the builder sanitizer, closing both render-time and import/storage paths. Release ancestry shows the BIC first in product tag v2.2.9 and the direct fix first in product tag v3.16.0 (v3.15.2 predates it). For @typebot.io/js, `git diff js-v0.9.21..js-v0.9.22 --` shows the sanitizing change and tag js-v0.9.22 points exactly at 474ecbf46bc47a75265bada2599f12b2179de375; npm registry metadata confirms 0.9.22 was published on 2026-03-23. Thus repository and registry evidence establish 0.9.22 as the first actually patched package release, notwithstanding the advisory metadata's broader `< 0.10.1` range/0.10.1 first-patched declaration; 0.10.1 also contains the fix.
reasoning: The root cause is not the 2026 accessibility refactor or the 2022 bot-v2 migration: both preserve or copy an existing unsafe custom-icon design. The smallest real first-writer is the focused June 2022 rating-feature commit b1aecf843b28e0c06cf7c43f59cc5ebd661da416, whose parent lacks the rating renderer and whose own diff creates the uncontrolled input and dangerous HTML sink together. The 2026 fix directly removes exploitability with SVG sanitization at the sink plus builder-side sanitization. AI attribution is judged solely from the BIC commit object; it identifies a human author/committer and contains no AI marker, so the supported closed verdict is NOT_AI.
